requests.government: Bay County Board of County Commissioners
requests.subject: Public records request: line-item budgets by fund and department, FY2016-FY2025 and FY2027
requests.body:
Under Chapter 119, Florida Statutes, I’m requesting the complete adopted budget, in as much detail as your records hold, for each of these fiscal years:

- FY2016 (Oct 1, 2015 to Sep 30, 2016)
- FY2017 (Oct 1, 2016 to Sep 30, 2017)
- FY2018 (Oct 1, 2017 to Sep 30, 2018)
- FY2019 (Oct 1, 2018 to Sep 30, 2019)
- FY2020 (Oct 1, 2019 to Sep 30, 2020)
- FY2021 (Oct 1, 2020 to Sep 30, 2021)
- FY2022 (Oct 1, 2021 to Sep 30, 2022)
- FY2023 (Oct 1, 2022 to Sep 30, 2023)
- FY2024 (Oct 1, 2023 to Sep 30, 2024)
- FY2025 (Oct 1, 2024 to Sep 30, 2025)
- FY2027 (Oct 1, 2026 to Sep 30, 2027)

For each year, please include:

1. Appropriations (expenditures) for every fund, broken down by department and division (cost center) and by account or object code (personnel services, operating expenses, capital outlay, debt service, grants and aids, transfers, reserves), with the line-item amounts.
2. Revenues for every fund by source and account (taxes, fees, intergovernmental, grants, charges for services, transfers in, fund balance carried forward).
3. Authorized positions (FTEs) by department, if the budget lists them.
4. The adopted capital improvement program or capital budget for that year.
5. The budget ordinance or resolution that adopted it, with its exhibits, and, if available, the final amended budget at year end.

A line-item report or export from your financial system (Excel or CSV) is ideal. The full budget book in PDF works too. If any of these are already posted online, a link is all I need, and if a year or item can’t be found, please send what exists rather than holding the rest.

To save a step, you can email the files to baycounty@ingest.baycounty.me, or upload them at https://baycounty.me/staff (we can give your finance or clerk staff a free sign-in). Nothing is published until it has been checked, and the same address works for future check registers, budget reports and contract lists.

This is a non-commercial request. These records will be used to show residents how the budget has changed over time on BayCounty.me, an independent public-records site for Bay County. If fulfilling it will cost more than $25, please send an estimate before starting.

Thank you,
Jeremy McSpadden
BayCounty.me
